h2. Acceptance Criteria

* Searchable by tag, base_model, format
* Migration scripts ready

h2. Goal

Any model produced by a workflow — fine-tuned, distilled, quantized — can be served through a stable OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with one click, with auto-shutdown to control costs.

h2. MVP scope

vLLM serving on the same provisioned GPU, OpenAI-compatible endpoint, auto-shutdown after configured TTL, "Try it" chat box in run viewer. Multi-LoRA dynamic adapter routing (LoRAX-style) is V1.

h2. V1+ scope

Multi-LoRA dynamic adapter routing (host 50 fine-tunes on 1 GPU), Ollama/SGLang/llama.cpp endpoint variants, autoscaling, persistent always-on serving tier with billing, custom domain + API key UI, production traffic capture (OpenPipe-style), inference cost dashboard, speculative decoding, Langfuse observability, batch inference.

h2. Owner

Backend lead with ML support on the vLLM container, Designer on the "Try it" chat surface.
